title: Test play won't work on my new pc

posts.author: cchmaster
posts.body:
I bought a new pc few months ago and so far it can run every software and game I own without any problem.
It runs MZ(steam ver) perfectly, which I'm mainly using.
It can run MV(steam ver), but when I hit the test play button, icons on my destop flashes and nothing happens.
My MV version is 1.6.3 now. I created a new project and the version of rpg_core.js is 1.6.2, but the result remains the same.
I also run a steam file check for MV, it missed some files and was automatically fixed, but again, with no luck. Nothing changed.
I'd like to ask what I can do now?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
this can happen if either the exe or the index.html are missing from the project directory, can you check if they are there? Steam cannot veryfy the projects themselves.
and this most likely happened due to a false positive from one of your protection programs deleting the exe

posts.author: cchmaster
posts.body:
@utunnels
Yes, it's win11.
@Andar
Yes, the index.html is in the folder.
This is a new created project folder.
After verifying MV's files, I created a new project, but it's the same still.
I've just removed and reinstalled MV, and it's the same.
I've also installed VXA, and it runs fine.
Now I really don't know what I can do.

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body: What if you deploy the game, can you run it from there?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
1) what is the full path to your project, beginning from the drive letter?
some folders are restricted and are not supposed to have the project in them
2) can you check your antivirus and firewall if they might have blocked testplay due to a false positive? SWome protection programs cannot detect the difference  between a website virus trying to infect your computer and a local HTML game accessing its own files

posts.author: cchmaster
posts.body:
@utunnels
Tried. No, I run the deployed game.exe, and again, icons on my desktop flashes. That's it.
@Andar
My path is
C:\Users\jjh\Documents\RMMV
All my RM projects, MZ, MV, VXA, are in Documents folder.
I tried to move my folder to Desktop, and it's the same.
I only use win11 protection, no other antivirus software.
Checked the history. I didn't see anything like blocking or freezing.
Is this possible some kind of bug that I need to report?

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
OK it seems your system can't run the specific version of nw.js
You can confirm it by going to RPG Maker MV's isntall folder, find the folder nwjs-win-test, and run game.exe from there. Can you see a window appears or not?
Edit*
Don't think reporting a bug makes any difference, it is called a legacy engine for some reason.
Your best bet is upgrading nw.js manually.
